description: Java class DataList extending ListActivity for displaying and interacting with database query results in an Android app.

classes.name: DataList
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays data from a content provider query, allows requerying, and handles item clicks to show details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, performs a query, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Deactivates the cursor when activity stops.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requeries the cursor and updates the activity title when resuming.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with a requery option.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks, gathers data, and starts a Details activity.
